content: In case a ComIPduCallout is configured for an I - PDU with ComIPduDirection configured to RECEIVE, the AUTOSAR COM module shall always invoke this I - PDU callout independently from the received d ata (e.g. I - PDU counter values) and the call shall take place before receiver side I - PDU counter handling is performed.
If reception deadline monitoring timer expires, AUTOSAR Com module shall r estart it.
Upstream requirements: SRS_Com_02058 If reception deadline monitoring timer expires, AUTOSAR Com module shall restart it.
